@@U03823@@
Nimblest of the nimble, 赫耳墨斯 then proves himself the master of artful devices, the patron god of thieves and rascals and all self-seekers. In a flash he’s stolen the sea god’s trident, the sword from 阿瑞斯’s scabbard, 阿波罗’s bow and arrows, Hephaestus’s tongs, and would have stolen Father 宙斯’s lightning were he not in fear of the fire. He wrestled and tripped up baby 厄洛斯, and while she fondled him filched the belt from 维纳斯’ waist. (Music of ravishing pure melody played on strings is heard from the cavern. All listen, and soon are deeply moved. The music continues with full orchestra until indicated.)

@@U03825@@
Listen! Hear these ravishing sounds! Free yourselves of the ancient fables, cast off your gods, they have no meaning now. Now we make greater demands. What moves the heart must come from the heart.

@@U03826@@
(She withdraws toward the rocks.)

@@U03828@@
If even you, dread being, are moved by these pleasing sounds, we who are newly restored to life are moved to tears. Let the sun lose its splendor as long as there is light in the soul, as long as in the heart's core we find what all the world denies us.
translation:
@@U03823@@
赫耳墨斯是敏捷中最敏捷的人，他证明了自己是巧妙装置的大师，是小偷、流氓和所有自私者的守护神。转眼之间，他偷走了海神的三叉戟、阿瑞斯鞘中的剑、阿波罗的弓箭、赫菲斯托斯的火钳，如果不是因为害怕火焰，他甚至会偷走宙斯神父的闪电。他摔跤并绊倒了小厄洛斯，当她抚摸他时，他从维纳斯腰间偷走了腰带。 （洞穴里传出令人陶醉的纯弦乐曲，所有人都听着，很快就被深深地感动了。音乐在完整的管弦乐声中继续，直到指示为止。）

@@U03825@@
听着！听到这些令人陶醉的声音！把你们自己从古老的寓言中解放出来，抛弃你们的诸神，它们现在已经没有任何意义了。现在我们提出了更高的要求。感动人心的，一定是发自内心的。

@@U03826@@
（她退到岩石边。）

@@U03828@@
如果连你这个恐惧的人都被这些悦耳的声音感动的话，我们这些刚刚复活的人也会感动得流泪。只要灵魂里还有光明，只要我们在内心深处找到了全世界都否认的东西，就让太阳失去它的光彩吧。
